scope: Preserve the retained lieutenant faction comm-link while deriving its reinforcement from restored Publish 14 faction rank and learned PRE-CU combat skills instead of the removed NGE player level.

eraEvidence.targetEra: Publish 14.1 PRE-CU faction and skill progression with retained expansion content
findings: Publish 14.1 players progress through learned skill boxes and have no NGE combat level.
The restored faction rank is an independent persisted value from zero through fifteen and already governs faction promotion.
The retained comm-link authors reinforcement templates only for ranks seven through twelve, so higher PRE-CU ranks must reuse the highest authored template rather than request a missing creature row.

expected.combatDifficultyAuthority: skill.getPrecuEncounterDifficulty from learned PRE-CU combat skill boxes
